C258.notes: SER AS-VN-001. Photo confirmed · user shorthand 1953. Reverse three rice stalks tied with ribbon · VIET-NAM · 20 SU (three-dragon obverse / date not shown — Joseph dated 1953). State of Vietnam aluminum small change — Bảo Đại / early Ngô Đình Diệm years, before the Republic of Vietnam name stuck and long before reunification. Same national rice motif thread as modern SRV C232 / AS-VN-002 (2003 1000đ wreath) but a different chapter: French-Union / Cold War Saigon pocket money for market rice and cyclo fares. Second Vietnam flip; not a new country (#39 already). Vietnam flips now 2.
